MESSAGE FROM THE PRINCIPAL

                                     It gives me great pleasure to invite you to take an initial peek into
                            the heart that beats behind the appealing façade of Ujani Majuli Kherkatia
                            College. I thank you for your interest in this exceptional institution which
                            has recorded five decades of constant development, in the course of
                            which it has accomplished much, making it one of the colleges recognized
                            for its excellence and therefore, much sought after by the fresh applicants.
                                     Teaching profession concerns not simply with passing on
                            information or knowledge but with awakening a desire to learn and
provide means of learning. Teaching is never tedious. It is full of change and variety. Teachers
stimulate intellectual curiosity and inculcate the spirit of enquiry, of a national and scientific outlook.
But to know is not enough. If there is desire to share the knowledge, then it is also essential to know
how to do it. The essence of all good teaching is growth, so that the teacher shall keep abreast not
only of the growing students, but of changing ideas in his subject in a changing world. For this, one
should remain interested and involved in exploring all the methods of communication A really
educated man with integrated personality is bound to be good and he enjoys unbounded capacity
for doing well. His noble sentiments and his highly awakened intelligence bless him with a rare
fervor which leads him on the path of virtue. The greatest virtue in man is to be good and to do well
and to do good boldly to all friends and foes alike.
         The Ujani Majuli Kherkatia College tradition happily brings together sound academic
achievement with an extensive, vibrant co-curricular programme that includes sports, and
leadership training programmes. Our mission is to inculcate the love of knowledge in our students
and, for this; we aim to develop the skills and demeanour of lifelong ‘learning,’ essential for making
responsible global citizens. This will make them immensely capable of facing the future with
resilience and optimism. On the deeper level, we try to instill the values of respect and trust in
relationships that are the foundation of real success.
         At Ujani Majuli Kherkatia then, we believe that ‘education’ is a wholesome, holistic exercise
and as such we strive to give a whole new meaning to the word. Coupling this basic premise with the
idea of a sense of belonging to one family "the U.M.K. College family" we look at ourselves as ‘care-
givers.’ We care for the mind ours is a sterling academic institution; we care for the person—the
accent is on the all-round development of personality. The healthy environs, rich culture ambiance,
disciplined way of functioning equip to bring the best out our learners and enable them to face the
hardships of life and its challenges that come in their path, confidently. I welcome you all on joining
this prestigious institution. May I take this opportunity to thank all of you for becoming our partners
in education, for joining our journey in inspiring lives and realizing dreams.

 ADMISSION PROCEDURE:

How to Apply

1. Generally, admission starts after announcement of H.S.L.C. and Higher Secondary Examination
results. Prospectus and Prescribed Application Form for admission can be obtained from the Online
Portal for FYUGP (SAMARTH e-gov suite) and for H.S. (DARPAN).

2. Selection and admission is made on merit basis only.

3. There is reservation for SC, ST, OBС/МОВС, Physically Handicapped students having proficiency in
sports, culture, and NCC as per govt. rules.

4. Candidates seeking admission against reserved seats must submit attested copies of relevant
Certificates from appropriate authority.

5. Students willing to offer Major Subject have to face written test/ Interview to be organized by
concern Department.

6. Candidates who have passed the qualifying examination earlier than the current year, must
submit a Gap-Certificate from the Head of the institution, attended last regarding his/her activities
during that period.

Selection Procedure:

         Candidates are selected for admission into H.S. and Degree Course strictly on merit basis
subjected to the approval of the 'Admission Committee'. The Admission Committee of the college
scrutinizes the 'Admission Forms' and list of selected candidates is prepared on merit basis and the
same list is displayed on the College Notice Board prior to the Interview cum admission Process.

Reservation
Reservation for SC, ST(P), ST(H) and OВС/МОВС are maintained strictly as per the Government of
Assam rules

                OBC : 15%                       SC :      7%

                ST (P) : 10%                    ST (H): 5%

Interview cum Admission Schedule

        The dates of interview cum admission into different courses are notified on the college
notice board, college website. Immediately must have to appear personally before an interview
board on date on date original documents, photocopies of which are furnished with the admission
form.

ATTENDANCE

        Regular attendance is the most important and vital aspect of any formal education system.
The college always insists on regular attendance of students and they must attend at least 85%
classes held during an Academic Session. Students fail to attend minimum 80% of classes held will


                                                                                          3|P a ge
 either be considered Non-Collegiate or Dis-Collegiate and they will not be considered for awarding of
Post-Metric-Scholarship.



EVALUATION:

(a) The college conducts sessional tests, unit tests, class tests, terminal examinations for periodic
assessment of students. Departmental seminars, group discussion, home assignments are the
regular features of the assessment procedure as per Dibrugarh University and AHSEC guidelines.

(b) Final examinations are conducted by the ASSEB Div- II and Dibrugarh University.

(c) There is an internal assessment of 40 marks for each paper on a subject for degree courses
evaluation of which depends exclusively on attendance, performance on sessional test, home
assignment, participation in seminars etc. and good conduct.

HOSTEL FACILITY:

        There are hostel facilities for both boys' and girls' within the college campus. Separate
application is to be submitted in prescribed form for the hostel admission as per notification.
Adequate care is taken to provide all necessary facilities to the boarders. Allotments of seats are
made on merit and distance basis. Students admitted to the hostel shall have to follow hostel rules
which will be made available to the boarders by the respective wardens. Reservation procedure will
be maintained in allotment of seat. Electricity, permanent lavatory and water supply facilities are
available in the hostel.

COLLEGE CANTEEN:

      There is a college canteen within the college campus. The canteen runs under the
management/supervision of a committee constituted by the college authority.

OTHER FACILITIES:

1. Free Health Check-up for Students & Community.

2. Adoptation of Poor and Meritorius Students by the Principal, Teachers & Office Staff.

3. Special Classes for slow learner.

4. Well equiped Digital Class Room.

5. E-learning Platforms (N.List & ONOS)

COMMON ROOМ:

        There are separate common rooms for boys and girls. Indoor games and recreation facilities
are available in the common rooms.

SCHOLARSHIP:

       The following scholarships are available for eligible students of both higher secondary and
degree courses.

                                                                                           4|P a ge
 (a) National Merit Scholarship.

(b) State Merit Scholarship.

(c) Post-Metric-Scholarship for ST/SC/OBС/ MOBC students. Scholars are required to observe strict
discipline and regular attend/dance failing which their scholarship may be withdrawn.


STUDENTS' UNION:
       The College Student Union is an elected body of the students. The union carries out
programs like games & sports and literary competitions under the guidance of professor in-charges.

CAREER COUNSELING AND PLACEMENT CELL:
        There is a career Guidance and Counseling Cell in the college headed by a Prof-in-charge to
advise students for selecting career opportunities. Students may collect requisite information on job
opportunities from the cell.

GRIEVANCEREDDRESSAL CELL:
        The college has a Grievance Reddressal Cell headed by the principal to look into the
grievance of the students and college employees (teaching and non-teaching)

STUDENT AID-FUND:
        As an innovative measures and a part of best practices, the college authority has formulated
the "Students Aid Fund" in order to provide financial aid and other assistance to economically back-
ward meritorious students

EXTENSION ACTIVITIES:
        The college undertakes extension activities/ programs by involving students and teachers in
the surrounding of the college.

INTERNAL QUALITY ASSURANCE CELL (IQAC) :
         The college constituted the cell in 2005 in the light of the NAAC's guide-lines. The purpose of
the cell is to ensure awareness among the stake-holders of the institution, bringing about quality
consciousness among the concerned section for improvement and advancement of the college.

ALUMNI ASSOCIATION:
        The college has an Alumni Association that holds its meeting periodically to interact with the
ex-students. It is desired that all out-going students of college would join the association and there
by become an active partner in developmental works of the college.

COLLEGE UNIFORM :
      BOYS: White shirt and black colour pant/ trousers.
      GIRLS: Pink colour paijama and chunri with white Kurta.
      (No college student is to enter the college uniform).

GENERAL RULES FOR MAINTENANCE OF DISCIPLINE:

    The college authority is taking continuous steps for maintaining discipline and healthy academic
atmosphere in the college campus, students must abide by the rules of discipline, maintain decency
in dress and behavior, and students shall also maintain perfect silence in the class room. They must
not disturb teaching atmosphere by loitering in the corridors.

    Taking intoxicating drugs, smoking, frolicking, carrying weapons in and around the college
campus are strictly prohibited. The college campus is declared as Tobacco Free Zone. Students shall
also take care of college property, furniture apparatus etc. they shall also help the college authority
in preserving clean lines at campus.

    Violation of any of the rules of discipline, irregular attendance in class, damage of college
property, and disorderly behavior to any member of the college staff as well as follow students in
any form will be seriously viewed and may even invite disciplinary action. Students shall keep their
bicycles, bikes and scooters in the parking shed provided for the purpose. No vehicle is allowed to
keep in or around the college campus.

IDENTITY & LIBRARYCARDS:

   All students are required to collect their identity cards from the college office just after
admission. They are to keep these cards wearing the neck while in the college.

ALL FORMS OF RAGGINGIN THE COLLEGE AND HOSTEL CAMPUS ARE STRICTLY PRO. HIBITED

STUDENT CHARACTER:

As an inevitable drive for quality assurance in the college, there are bilateral responsibilities of the
students; the college has displayed them on the board outside the office. Students are specially
instructed to read and practice them in letter and spirit.

U.M.K. COLLEGE LIBRARY

ABOUT THE LIBRARY:

        The Central Library of Ujani Majuli Kherkatia College is one of the best library in Ujani
Majuli. Library provides effective service to the student. The library of Ujani Majuli Kherkatia
College established in 1987 (1973) started with minimal figures of books. College library is a growing
organism. At present library grow up to collection above (13,000) Thirteen Thousand of Volumes.
Beside these collection of books 2 Journal, 3 Magazine, 2 News papers both Assamese and English.
The library building covers 1500 square land in ground floor and 1000 square cover in upper floor.
Beside Library building there is one ICT room for computes students. Student can avail information
through internet.


LIBRARY STAFF:

Mr. Jitendra Doley, Library Bearer.



GENERAL RULES & REGULATIONS OF THE LIBRARY:

2.00 pm)

2. Issue Time: WEEK DAYS 11.00 A.M. to 2.00 P.M.

3. The library Card Holder is responsible for any loss or damage of books borrowed.

4. A general student can avail one library card at a time.

5. A honours students can avail two library cards.

6. One book is issued for 15 days against one library card.

7. The loss of library card must be reported immediately to the librarian. A duplicate card would be

issued on payment of Rs.20/- only.

 ASSAMESE:

The Department:

        The Department of Assamese is one of the leading and prominent departments of
Ujani Majuli Kherkatia College, Majuli. Since its establishment, the department has been
dedicated to promoting Assamese language, literature, culture, and regional heritage through
quality teaching and academic activities. The department offers Undergraduate Major
(Honours) and General courses under Dibrugarh University and Higher Secondary courses
under AHSEC.
        The department aims to create an excellent center for language and literary studies in
Majuli, Assam, and also aspires to introduce various certificate courses in regional languages
such as Mising and Deori through Assamese studies.
        The department has consistently maintained a good academic record through regular
classroom teaching, student mentoring, seminars, project works, and innovative learning
practices.

 ECONOMICS:

        While establishing the College to spread higher education in this remote and
backward corner of Majuli, Economics was offered among other subjects as a pass course
subject in the Degree level. The subject along with others got due permission from the
Dibrugarh University, the affiliating University of the College. The Honors’ course was
started from the year 1991-92. Since inception the subject has been able to fulfill the needs of
the desirous students of this area.

Moto of the Department:

      To prepare students for acquiring applied knowledge of economics to enhance their
employability and entrepreneurship.

Vision of the Department:

       The main vision of Economics department is to impart theoretical and applied
knowledge of Economics. To create a collaborative teaching, learning and research
environment that emphasizes social responsibility, ethical decision making and a global
perspective.

 EDUCATION:

education among different communities in the remote and interior of Majuli district. But the
department of education could not be established due to certain academic problems. In the
year 1998 education department was established as pass course in the degree level and got
Govt. concurrence in the year 2008. The major course of education department was
introduced in the year of 2024. Since the inception of the education dept., it has been able to
fulfill the needs of the desired students of this area.
